🎮 LOCAL CO-OP · UP TO 4 PLAYERS
CASUALeasiest · keep gear & items on death · no permadeath
NORMALa fair fight · lose items on death · character survives
HARDtoughest · lose items · a 2nd death is permanent
Player 1 plays on keyboard & mouse. Plug in controllers and press START (or A) on each to claim a slot — you can also drop in mid-run anytime. Everyone shares a split-screen view and each player manages their own build & menus in-game (press Back/Select on your controller).
